provenance.scope: Captured chronological public observations/actions, not a native replay or future model outcome. Seed1 history begins at its actual quiet interval start turn2817; only StairReevaluation inputs are retained in historical snapshots. Seed6 retains consecutive full snapshots around the vanished wizard/no-damage unseen flame. Endpoint snapshots are complete recorded after observations. Actions omit assessment only. Final bans are reconstructed from observed traversals; spent probes are consumed at their captured action boundaries.
